content.objective: Nói về dự định hoặc điều sắp xảy ra nhìn từ một thời điểm trong quá khứ bằng was / were going to, was / were about to và would.
explanation: Was / were going to + động từ: dự định trong quá khứ, thường không thành hiện thực. I was going to call you, but I forgot.
Was / were about to + động từ (hoặc was on the point of + V-ing): sắp sửa làm thì bị chen ngang. We were about to leave when the phone rang.

Would + động từ: tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ, hay gặp trong câu tường thuật và kể chuyện. She said she would help me. I knew the trip would be difficult. Little did they know that they would never meet again.
Khi động từ chính ở quá khứ (said, thought, knew), will thường chuyển thành would: I thought you would come.

Văn trang trọng còn dùng was / were to + động từ để nói điều về sau đã thật sự xảy ra, như một định mệnh: He was to become president twenty years later. Was / were to have + V3 nói dự định đã không thành: She was to have married him, but he died. Ngoài ra was / were due to (theo lịch) và quá khứ tiếp diễn (đã hẹn trước) cũng chỉ tương lai trong quá khứ: The train was due to leave at six. I was meeting him at six, but he cancelled.
usage: Xin lỗi vì kế hoạch dang dở: I was going to tell her the truth, but I didn't have the chance.
Kể chuyện bị gián đoạn: The plane was about to take off when the storm started.
Kể lại lời hứa: Last year he promised that he would never be late again.

structures.label: Dự định cũ
structures.pattern: chủ ngữ + was / were going to + động từ nguyên mẫu
structures.example: I was going to call you, but I forgot.

structures.label: Sắp sửa
structures.pattern: chủ ngữ + was / were about to + động từ nguyên mẫu; chủ ngữ + was / were on the point of + V-ing
structures.example: We were about to leave when the phone rang.

structures.label: Tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ
structures.pattern: said / knew / thought + (that) + chủ ngữ + would + động từ nguyên mẫu
structures.example: I knew the trip would be difficult.

structures.label: Was to
structures.pattern: chủ ngữ + was / were to + động từ nguyên mẫu; chủ ngữ + was / were to have + V3
structures.example: He was to become president twenty years later.

examples.en: I was going to call you, but I forgot.
examples.vi: Tôi định gọi bạn nhưng lại quên mất.

examples.en: They were going to get married, but they cancelled the wedding.
examples.vi: Họ đã định cưới nhưng rồi huỷ đám cưới.

examples.en: We were about to leave when the phone rang.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi vừa định đi thì điện thoại reo.

examples.en: She was on the point of leaving when he arrived.
examples.vi: Cô ấy đã sắp đi thì anh ấy tới.

examples.en: She said she would help me the next day.
examples.vi: Cô ấy nói hôm sau sẽ giúp tôi.

examples.en: I knew the trip would be difficult.
examples.vi: Tôi biết chuyến đi sẽ vất vả.

examples.en: Little did they know that they would never see each other again.
examples.vi: Họ đâu biết rằng sẽ không bao giờ gặp lại nhau.

examples.en: At that time he was a poor student; he was to become president twenty years later.
examples.vi: Khi ấy anh ta chỉ là một sinh viên nghèo; hai mươi năm sau anh ta trở thành tổng thống.

examples.en: She was to have married him, but he died in the war.
examples.vi: Lẽ ra cô ấy đã cưới anh ta, nhưng anh ta mất trong chiến tranh.

mistakes.wrong: The film was about start when we arrived.
mistakes.right: The film was about to start when we arrived.
mistakes.noteVi: Cần đủ about to + động từ.

mistakes.wrong: I thought you will come to the party.
mistakes.right: I thought you would come to the party.
mistakes.noteVi: Nhìn từ quá khứ (thought) dùng would.

mistakes.wrong: I was going to calling you.
mistakes.right: I was going to call you.
mistakes.noteVi: Sau going to là động từ nguyên mẫu.
